title: Ex-UPLB school paper editors condemn student journalists’ arrest

blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — As many as 18 former editors-in-chief (EICs) of UPLB Perspective, the official student publication of the University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB), condemned the arrest and detention of student journalists during protests against the visit of United States President Donald Trump for the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit
